newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Glen Dimplex buys 19 percent into France's Muller.
newsitem.headline: Glen Dimplex buys 19 percent into France's Muller.

text.p: Glen Dimplex, Irish manufacturers of electric heating products, said on Thursday it had acquired a 19 percent shareholding in Muller S.A. of France.

A company statement said the investment move by the two companies would broaden the group's range of products on the world market and allow a joint investigation to identify areas of opportunity for commercial and industrial synergies in Europe.

Muller, headquartered in Paris, has annual sales of 65 million Irish pounds with a 30 percent share of the installed electric heating market in France and employs 800 people at four manufacturing locations in France.
Glen Dimplex, a privately owned company, is the largest manufacturer of electric heating products in the world.
